headline: NNS Holding Reports Post-Closing Acceptance Results for OCI Offer
summary: NNS Holding Cyprus reported the results of the post-closing acceptance period for its cash takeover offer for OCI. The press release was issued under Dutch public takeover regulations.
why: OCI N.V. is a Netherlands-based global producer and distributor of nitrogen products and methanol.

impacts.name: OCI N.V.
impacts.why: OCI is the subject of the public cash takeover offer by NNS Holding.
